message: I've successfully updated the Lucky Card Reveal cinematic sequence! Progressive materialization using dynamically calculated CSS mask-image radial gradients has been implemented to forge the card over time on each strike. The Framer Motion sequence was carefully synchronized to these exact strike moments, ensuring the physical card violently jolts and recoils in unison with the visuals and audio impacts. The final strike now serves as a powerful crescendo with thicker beams, larger bursts, complete materialization, and a smooth residual cooldown phase post-flip.
